## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes proposed in this Pull Request, including the problem they solve or features they add.

Fixes # (issue number) / Relates to # (issue number)

## Type of Change
Please check the options that apply:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)
- [ ] Code refactoring or performance optimization (no functional changes)

## Checklist
Before submitting this PR, please check all that apply:
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines.
- [ ] My commits are structured according to **Conventional Commits** (e.g., `feat(detection): ...`).
- [ ] Every commit has been signed off with DCO (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have formatted my Go code using `gofmt` and vetted the changes via `make lint`.
- [ ] I have verified that all interactive frontend components updated contain unique `id` attributes for testing.
- [ ] I have verified that the Docker stack runs and compiles successfully with my changes.

## Verification & Screenshots
Please describe how you manually tested these changes (e.g. using `go test`, cURL requests, or dashboard verification). Provide screenshots or gifs of any UI modifications.
